title: Synthetic Data Generation and Evaluation
summary: A small demonstration project that trains a synthesizer on a tabular dataset.csv to generate synthetic samples, then evaluates and visualizes the results. It uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, metadata schema, and evaluate_quality API to generate and score the synthetic data.
evidence: new_samples.py:2-4 imports GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, evaluate_quality from sdv; line 37 calls evaluate_quality(df, synthetic_data, ...)
